# HELP tokenspeed:cache_hit_tokens_total Prompt tokens of finished requests served from the prefix cache.
# HELP tokenspeed:completion_tokens_total Output tokens of requests that ended, including a prefill role's bootstrap token.
# HELP tokenspeed:decode_time_seconds Wall time from the first token to the request's end.
# HELP tokenspeed:generation_tokens_total Generated tokens committed by decode forwards.
# HELP tokenspeed:grammar_queue_reqs Admissions waiting for their grammar to compile.
# HELP tokenspeed:iteration_tokens_total Tokens scheduled in one scheduler forward step.
# HELP tokenspeed:jit_serving_compile_seconds_total Wall time spent in Triton and CuTe DSL kernel compilations after startup.
# HELP tokenspeed:jit_serving_compiles_total Triton and CuTe DSL kernel compilations after startup; each one stalls the forward thread.
# HELP tokenspeed:kv_cache_usage_perc Fraction of device KV pages in use (0-1).
# HELP tokenspeed:kv_token_usage_perc Fraction of usable KV pages resident (active plus reclaimable prefix-cache entries), 0-1.
# HELP tokenspeed:kv_transfer_failures_total KV transfers aborted on failure: send failures on the prefill node, and rooms failed on prefill-node loss on the decode node. Timeouts are counted separately.
# HELP tokenspeed:kv_transfer_latency_seconds Wall time of one KV cache transfer send to a peer.
# HELP tokenspeed:kv_transfer_size_bytes_total Bytes one KV cache transfer send moved to a peer.
# HELP tokenspeed:kv_transfer_timeouts_total KV transfers that timed out, by transfer stage.
# HELP tokenspeed:num_capacity_aborted_requests_total Requests the scheduler aborted because a capacity retraction could not image its victim (retraction snapshot pool, image rows or Host L2 exhausted); clients may resubmit them. Forced retractions from --debug-force-retraction-interval aborted the same way count too.
# HELP tokenspeed:num_decode_prealloc_queue_reqs Decode requests waiting for their prefill peer to connect.
# HELP tokenspeed:num_decode_transfer_queue_reqs Decode requests whose KV a transfer still pins.
# HELP tokenspeed:num_free_tokens KV tokens not held by active requests (empty plus evictable).
# HELP tokenspeed:num_nan_aborted_requests_total Requests terminated by the NaN guard (NaN in logits or an out-of-vocab sampled token id).
# HELP tokenspeed:num_preemptions_total Requests preempted by a capacity retraction: the scheduler suspended a resident request (its pages imaged to the Host snapshot pool; it later resumes by restore, nothing is recomputed) to free Device pages for a blocked admission. One increment per retraction victim per round, counted from the plan's snapshot-store ops; forced retractions from --debug-force-retraction-interval count too. A retraction whose victim cannot be imaged aborts it instead — see tokenspeed:num_capacity_aborted_requests.
# HELP tokenspeed:num_prefill_awaiting_destination_pages KV pages in the block tables of the prefill requests waiting for their decode destination, counted as tokenspeed:num_free_tokens counts pages; blocks held outside the tables (such as a pending in-forward State checkpoint) are not included.
# HELP tokenspeed:num_prefill_awaiting_destination_reqs Prefill requests computed and waiting for their decode destination (--disaggregation-decode-allocation-policy independent); tokenspeed:num_prefill_inflight_queue_reqs counts them too.
# HELP tokenspeed:num_prefill_inflight_queue_reqs Prefill requests whose KV a transfer still pins.
# HELP tokenspeed:num_prefill_prealloc_queue_reqs Prefill requests waiting for their decode peer to connect.
# HELP tokenspeed:num_prefill_requeued_requests_total Prefill requests without a decode destination that the scheduler requeued to free pages or a request slot for requests whose destination is allocated (--disaggregation-decode-allocation-policy independent). The client sees nothing; the request is computed again.
# HELP tokenspeed:num_requests_running Requests with scheduler-side generation state (decode path).
# HELP tokenspeed:num_requests_waiting Requests waiting in the C++ scheduler queue.
# HELP tokenspeed:num_retracted_queue_reqs Requests suspended with a retraction image.
# HELP tokenspeed:num_used_tokens KV tokens held by resident pages (active plus reclaimable).
# HELP tokenspeed:prefill_requeued_tokens_total Prompt tokens the requeued prefill requests held in KV when requeued, prefix-cache hits included; an upper bound on what their next admission computes again.
# HELP tokenspeed:prefix_device_hit_tokens_total Admitted prompt tokens served from the Device prefix cache (L1).
# HELP tokenspeed:prefix_host_hit_tokens_total Admitted prompt tokens loaded from the Host cache (L2, including L3-supplied).
# HELP tokenspeed:prefix_l3_hit_tokens_total Token spans of successful storage keys (L3), counted per cache group.
# HELP tokenspeed:prefix_prompt_tokens_total Prompt tokens of admitted requests.
# HELP tokenspeed:prompt_tokens_total Prompt tokens of requests that ended, including aborted requests.
# HELP tokenspeed:request_queue_time_seconds Wall time from submission to the scheduler's waiting queue to first dispatch into a forward batch, observed once per request. Grammar-compile, pause-hold, and EPD embedding waits precede submission and are excluded, as are frontend and IPC wait.
# HELP tokenspeed:request_time_seconds Wall time from request creation to its end on this role (prefill: KV transfer done; decode: generation done).
# HELP tokenspeed:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total Accepted speculative draft tokens (excludes the bonus token sampled after verify).
# HELP tokenspeed:spec_decode_num_draft_tokens_total Draft tokens proposed across verify steps.
# HELP tokenspeed:spec_decode_num_drafts_total Number of speculative verify rounds (per request-slot).
# HELP tokenspeed:time_per_output_token_seconds Decode time divided by generated tokens after the first one.
# HELP tokenspeed:time_to_first_token_seconds Wall time from request creation to its first output token, on this role.
